title: Bar Marina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1, 40b, he recited the blessing “shehakol” over pieces before Rabbi Zeira and Rabbi Chiyya bar Va. In Shabbat, beginning of chapter 19, he once forgot to bring a circumcision knife before Shabbat; he asked Rabbi Ami, who prohibited it, then Rabbi Simon, who permitted it. Radbaz, responsum 362, reads “Bar Marta.”

notes.text: Bar Marina is the subject of “recited a blessing”; Zeira and Chiyya are those before whom he recited it. Radbaz’s alternative name is Bar Marta.

The supplied parenthesis says “over pieces” without specifying bread. The consulted Berakhot passage places Bar Merinah’s blessing in a discussion of rice preparations. In the consulted Shabbat passage Yudan corrects the order of the two consultations to Immi prohibiting, then Simon permitting. The Radbaz reading is cited as Hyman reports it; the exact responsum was not independently inspected.
